Exit

Leaders who decided to close a business or stop a line.

3 interviews　Read by theme

Succession/Exit/Pivot

Her father ran the line for 40 years. As his successor, she shut it down

Three years after she took over, orders for their main product — auto parts — had halved. What remained: craftsmen who’d worked for her father, and a production line losing money.

Mariko Hayase　Hayase Manufacturing8 min

New ventures/Exit/Decisions

She knew it would fail. It still took her a year to stop

The losses grew every month, and so did the messages from customers who believed in the product. Every signal said stop. She rewrote her own exit criteria three times.

Nao Kuroda　SCALE LLC6 min

Exit/Comeback/Team

The morning after he decided to close the company, he couldn’t say a word

Revenue had fallen by two-thirds, and the cash would last two more months. He came in to announce the shutdown — and found his team had spent the night writing a rescue plan.

Ryo Saeki　NORTHBOUND Inc.8 min
